title: ServerEvent
description: Envelope of every event the server pushes over the mc.v1 WebSocket (docs/api/WEBSOCKET-EVENTS.md §2.1). Each event type's data payload gets its own schema in this directory as it is implemented. Envelope changes require a new protocol version.

id.description: Unique event ID (UUIDv7); clients deduplicate on it.

type.description: Event name, `resource.action` (e.g. `message.reaction.added`); breaking revisions add a version suffix (`message.created.v2`). Clients ignore unknown types.

ts.description: Server time the event was produced, after commit (RFC 3339 UTC, milliseconds).

conversation_id.description: Present with change_seq on conversation-scoped message events.

change_seq.description: Conversation change-feed position after this change; a gap means events were missed and the client resynchronises through the change feed.

data.description: Event payload; its schema depends on `type`.
